resources.string: The stream stops and the box goes to sleep — the TV turns off with it
The stream stops; the box sleeps by its own settings
When the timer ends, the stream stops. To turn off the TV right away, Android must allow TwiCast to put the box to sleep.
This right does one thing only — turn off the screen. Without it the TV goes off by itself when the box falls asleep by its own settings.
Going to sleep in a minute
The stream will stop and the TV will turn off
TwiCast puts the box to sleep when the sleep timer ends, so the TV turns off with it. This right gives nothing else.
